paths.title: AI for Financial Analysts
paths.tagline: From variance narratives to a repeatable monthly reporting workflow — built with confidentiality and number-verification baked in.
paths.description: A six-lesson ladder for financial analysts covering the AI workflows that save real time without risking confidentiality or accuracy: turning a budget variance table into a clear narrative, summarizing filings and reports for a briefing without dropping a number, building reusable analysis frameworks and checklists, running cited sector research in Perplexity, drafting investment memos with built-in verification checkpoints, and designing a repeatable, auditable monthly reporting workflow.

paths.title: AI for Insurance Agents
paths.tagline: From plain-language policy explanations to a full client-communication template library — accurate, empathetic, and confidential by default.
paths.description: A six-lesson ladder for insurance agents covering the AI workflows that save real time without risking confidentiality or accuracy: explaining a policy in plain language a client actually understands, writing client follow-ups and renewal reminders that get responses, comparing two policy documents accurately, writing clear and empathetic claims communication, preparing for objection handling and needs-analysis conversations, and building a complete, maintained client-communication template library.
